ABANDON_ITEMS: Items from this quest that will be destroyed: %s
MAP_IN_COMBAT: The map can't be opened in combat.
EMPTY_DUNGEONS: No dungeon quests in your log.
EMPTY_RAIDS: No raid quests in your log.
EMPTY_PVP: No PvP quests in your log.
NO_QUESTIE: QuestieDB isn't loaded: where to go is unknown.
LAYER_TURN_INS_TIP: Ordaen Quests: whom to turn in a completed quest you show on the map to
LAYER_GIVERS_TIP: Ordaen Quests: where the next quest of a chain is given, when you show it on the map from its window
LAYER_NPC_TIP: Ordaen Quests: where an NPC stands, when another module shows it on the map (a recipe's trainer or vendor)
SETTING_FOLDED_SCROLL_TIP: A quest's page shows only its title on the parchment; a click unfolds its story and task.
SETTING_OWN_KEY: The quest log key opens Ordaen Quests
SETTING_OWN_KEY_TIP: Your Quest Log key (L) and its button in the menu open this window. Off: the game's quest log. While the log is docked on the map, both are the game's.
NOTHING_FOUND: No quest fits the search and the filter.
PANEL_XP_TEXT: Experience the log's completed quests give once turned in.
